proposedStyleProfile.shapeLanguage: Readable stylized rural silhouettes: faceted vegetation and rocks, timber farm buildings, pitched shingle roofs and simple agricultural props.

silhouetteHierarchy.guidance: Keep trunks, canopies, rock masses, and groundcover clusters readable at world scale.
Preserve the few large angular breaks that distinguish variants without adding fine noise.

detailScale.guidance: Use broad color blocks and authored facets; avoid microdetail that competes with the silhouette.

proposedStyleProfile.edgeTreatment: Retain authored hard-edged low-poly facets and clean silhouette transitions.
proposedStyleProfile.materialLanguage: Authored matte earth, straw, timber, muted red paint and weathered white walls with slate-gray roofs; preserve source texture and vertex colors.

surfaceVariation.guidance: Retain authored color variation; add no compiler-authored mottling.

exclusions: Do not add edge wear or dirt during catalog realization.

proposedStyleProfile.lightingIntent: Read as matte stylized outdoor forms under world-level lighting.
antiGoals: Do not infer interchangeability from the shared visual family.
Do not smooth away the authored faceted silhouette.
Do not replace authored materials with photorealistic textures.

selectionRationale: Eighteen visually inspected singleton entries selected for a coherent rural valley: complete exterior farm buildings, agricultural landmarks, market and campsite props, rock formation and flowering groundcover. Source names were discovery hints; visual and measured evidence decide admission.
reviewProcedure: Inspect canonical multiview RGB evidence and measured scale, source integrity, materials, bottom contact and part structure.
Preserve every selected source as a singleton; no folder- or name-based substitution grouping.
Keep interior traversal, interaction, light emission and engine behavior unasserted. The creator performs final Studio inspection.
This is an explicit user-delegated authoring decision, not independent human review or automated corpus qualification.
